items.title: Constellation CEO Sounds the Alarm: Data Center Demand Was a “Massive Overestimation.” Its Nuclear Contracts Run to the 2040s
items.summary: Key TakeawaysConstellation Energy CEO Joe Dominguez said utilities and grid operators made a “massive overestimation” of data center demand. Days earlier, Vistra’s CEO blamed speculative developers for overstated grid queues.

items.title: Vertiv Sinks 11% in a Week as Midterm Sweep Hits Data Center Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVertiv fell 11% in the past week after Democrats won Congress, reviving fears of a data center construction slowdown in Texas. The drop came less than two weeks after Vertiv beat estimates and raised its guidance.

items.title: Constellation Energy earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Constellation Energy Corp (CEG) reported Q3 on Nov 9, 2026. Adjusted EPS was $5.06 vs $3.72 expected, a 36% beat. Revenue was $9.55B vs $9.21B expected. The stock is $274.40 (+9.78%) as of 3:04 PM EST. That is well above the pre-market print of $260.37. The 52-week range is $228.63–$380.78, so shares remain about 28% below the high.
